AMENDMENT_SEMANTICS.rule: APPEND-ONLY. Both ancestors are left byte-unchanged. This amendment supersedes clauses ONLY in the single respect each entry states; every other word of the same clause continues to control.
AMENDMENT_SEMANTICS.how_to_read_the_three_together: Where this amendment is silent, v1.0.1 controls where it speaks, and v1.0.0 controls where v1.0.1 is also silent. Where this amendment names a v1.0.0 clause under SUPERSEDED_V100_CLAUSES, that clause is superseded ONLY in the stated respect - INCLUDING a v1.0.0 clause v1.0.1 never touched. Where this amendment names a v1.0.1 clause under SUPERSEDED_V101_CLAUSES, that clause is superseded ONLY in the stated respect. A reader who stops at v1.0.1 is reading a document that correctly reclassified PD-2 in its DEFINITION but left several of PD-2's CONSUMERS uncorrected; a reader who has only this amendment has a delta, not a contract. All three documents are required.
what_this_amendment_does: (1) PRIMARY FIX: propagates PD-2's CONDITIONAL status to every surviving consumer this lane can locate by grep - LIFECYCLE.phases[1].must_prove[1], the manifest's PC-P5, MINIMUM_PRIVILEGES.axes[3] and axes[6], and the manifest's NC-P4 and NC-P9 - without weakening PD-3 (no membership), PD-4 (is_super_admin false), the zero-PostgreSQL-grant finding, or MG-4.
(2) Corrects the false attribution of F-M11-07 to the v1.0.1 amendment; F-M11-07 is a v1.0.0 MEASURED_FACTS entry.
(3) Completes the OD5 restatement quotation SPC-7 introduced, which itself dropped a leading clause and truncated a trailing one.

(4) Resolves the contradiction between REVOCATION_LOCATOR_REQUIREMENT and custody_invariants_regardless_of_option's 'no subject id' rule without exposing a subject id in the general inventory row, and corrects OF-P9's claim that no inventory mechanism exists when LIFECYCLE phases 1/4/7 already require one.

(5) Introduces PRE-2's analogous materialization prerequisite, PRE-2B, on the same governing precedent PRE-1B established - the recertification this amendment consumes has the identical OCCURRED/MATERIALIZED gap PRE-1 had.
(6) Removes the unweakened PD-2-dependence from MINIMUM_PRIVILEGES that SPC-9 did not reach, and disentangles the two distinct files both informally called 'proxy.ts' inside PROXY_REFRESH_FOOTPRINT.
(7) Corrects two source-citation slips: 'six-line' comment that is five lines, and a null-check return range that included the if-statement's own line.
(8) Reconciles SPC-10's stated OD-P6 technical_recommendation status with the premise SPC-10 itself touched.
(9) Widens MGP-PD2's measurement scope to name the sibling on_auth_user_updated trigger, and states why it does not change PD-2 or PD-4's conclusions.

(10) Corrects CG-Q4/G-2's citation to name it as an EXTERNAL identifier from a sibling, unmerged lane, not as an in-tree fact of this branch, and replaces the unstable '(NB-1 through NB-9)' shorthand with addressable section names.
(11) Qualifies UNAVOIDABLE_WRITE_DISCLOSURE.bounding_rules[2]'s 'countable rather than estimated' claim against the proxy's own uncounted refresh write.
It does NOT answer OD-P1 through OD-P6. It does NOT perform any hosted read. It does NOT create, promote or provision anything.

entries.corrected_text: Revocation requires a locator (UUID or email) that ordinary evidence is forbidden from carrying, and that the general inventory row (custody_invariants_regardless_of_option) is ALSO forbidden from carrying. P2-8 introduces the locator record as a SEPARATE, narrower-audience artifact rather than an extension of the inventory row, resolving the contradiction; what remains open is only the OPERATIONAL mechanism (a specific storage location, access control implementation, and creation/consumption tooling) for that now-distinct locator record - a successor lane's work, not a definitional gap.
